description: Each month, holds the 2 major pairs with the strongest 3-month change. Short-horizon currency momentum (after Menkhoff et al. 2012). Falsified if 3-month leaders do not keep leading. Backtested on FinzData FX daily closes (spot: the price change only, no interest differential), costs as stated, re-run free on full history.
title: FX majors rotation · 3-month momentum · top 2 of 7 (spot)
